question.prompt: A bag contains 3 red balls and some white balls, identical except for color. If 1 ball is drawn at random, the probability of drawing a red ball is \(1/4\). How many white balls are in the bag?

solutions.explanation: Let the total number of balls be \(n\). Then \(3/n=1/4\), giving \(n=12\). Therefore, there are \(12-3=9\) white balls.
solutions.title: Solve the probability proportion

solutions.explanation: Since every ball is equally likely to be drawn, the red balls make up \(1/4\) of the total. View the total as four equal parts. The 3 red balls form one part, so each part has 3 balls. The other three parts are white, giving \(3\times3=9\) white balls.
solutions.title: Use four equal parts
